system.description:
Will Amp

You are charged with Data Release chakra and see it upgrading you in the following ways;

Allied Network. The Genwa that applied this status can now see and hear through your senses, as if they shared your perceptive abilities.

Relay Node. The Genwa that applied this status can cast their Hijutsu and have their originate from your space, using your senses to determine what they can see and hear.

Team Link. You radiate a 10-foot radius of neon light, all allied creatures within this radius gain a +1 bonus to their attacks and saving throws.

Signal Degradation. This state degrades quickly, dispelling itself at the end of the Genwa’s turn that applied this status, unless otherwise stated.
system.summary: The Genwa sees and casts through you. Allies within 10 feet get +1 to attacks and saves.

rules.text: Ends at the end of the applying Genwa's turn, unless its source says otherwise.
Team Link: +1 to allies' attacks and saves within 10 feet (at the table).
